end.summary:
Diya read and wrote some 4-digit numbers in words and numerals.
Diya correctly wrote 6,042 and 3,006 in numerals.
Diya correctly wrote 2,064 using place values, including an internal zero.
Diya practised expanded place values but mixed up how to show thousands, hundreds, tens and ones.
Diya joined spoken parts incorrectly once, such as treating “eight thousand, six hundred, fourteen” as 8,614.
end.parentNote: Diya practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers, including numbers with zeros inside them. Diya used place-value labels to explain that 6,042 has 6 thousands, 4 tens and 2 ones, and later used the same method for 2,064. Diya mixed up how spoken parts combine in 8,614 and the mix-up was not corrected after it was last seen. At home, practise a few numbers with a place-value chart, keeping a zero in its column and writing each nonzero place separately.
